text:
marta: Quick SOS: Nimbus has discovered the perfect sunbeam and will not vacate the UX chair until further notice. He has also appointed himself 'Head of Quiet.' Photo: https://imgur.com/a/nimbus-sunbeam :dog: :sunny:
diego: Nimbus is a whole mood. also he scheduled a 2pm 'nap review' and declined the calendar invite. :calendar: :zzz:
akash: Please share adoption details immediately. Also want to know if Nimbus approves of standing desks or only low-to-the-ground vibes. :raised_hands: :dog2:
marta: He prefers ergonomic cloud-level cushions. Camera: `Sony A7iii, 50mm, 1/200s, natural window light`. No treats were used as negotiation. :camera_flash:
facilities-bot: Reminder: Pets in common areas must be supervised. See policy: https://intranet/company/pets-policy. If Nimbus will be a recurring visitor, please register with People Ops for allergy tracking. :information_source:
lina: Nimbus just borked at my laptop notification. He demands silent standups. Proposing "Nimbus Time": one 15-min quiet block after lunch. Vote with :dog: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no.
diego: vote: :dog:. If Nimbus approves, I will bring a tiny velvet cape for honorary duties. :crown:
akash: vote: :dog:. Also open to branded nap pillows. Can we get a prototype?
marta: tally so far: diego :dog:, akash :dog:, lina :dog:. Nimbus is trending toward official status.
lina: small logistics: if you want to pet him, ask first. He appreciates gentle boops and will remove your pen if he deems it a threat. Also he slightly snores in binary. :ear: :laughing:
diego: Merch idea: "I survived Nimbus Time" stickers. willing to fund prototypes if Nimbus signs off. :sticker: :money_mouth_face:
akash: also wondering if Nimbus has preferred treat brand. Marta, pls advise (asking for my future gifting spreadsheet).
marta: He accepts small jerky bites and unsolicited compliments. He refuses biscuits with raisins (nope). Also he likes when you wave a Post-it like a tiny flag. :memo: :paw_prints:
lina: Facilities note: If Nimbus naps on a chair, please place the provided protective mat under him and wipe crumbs after. Mat is in the kitchenette drawer. :broom:
facilities-bot: Facilities acknowledged. Please keep commons tidy and report any recurring allergens via People Ops."
